understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level and continue until the game is won, while avoiding spikes and completing levels within the available attempts and turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions change the player's position on the grid, while gravity pulls the player in the current direction. Landing on a spike ends the attempt and restarts the level. Each level provides two attempts with up to 50 turns each. The recent actions showed horizontal movement under DOWN gravity; repeated movement can consume turns, and an action may fail to change position when blocked. No click or undo behavior was demonstrated.
